desc: Read input N and string S, then collect the 0-indexed positions of all '1's into a list.
Compute the transformed values $q_j = p_j - j$ for each '1' position $p_j$.
Find the median of the $q_j$ values. If $k$ is odd, the median is the middle element; if even, any value between the two middle elements works (we can pick either middle element).
Calculate the total cost as the sum of absolute differences between each $q_j$ and the median.
